title: Internal-mode radiation damping
question: For the fourth-order cubic–quintic NLS near a specified localized excited state, determine whether an isolated internal mode sheds energy into the continuous spectrum.
first_test: Derive a nonzero resonance coefficient or exhibit a symmetry that forbids coupling.

title: Traveling-wave velocity bounds
question: Classify velocities for which exponentially decaying traveling waves solve the fourth-order cubic–quintic NLS on the plane.
first_test: Identify an admissible traveling ansatz and prove existence or an exact velocity obstruction.

title: Two-soliton collision outcomes
question: For two initially separated coherent profiles with prescribed incoming phases and velocities, characterize elastic scattering, capture, or fragmentation in the full fourth-order flow.
first_test: Prove one asymptotic collision channel or construct a controlled inelastic example.

title: Excited-state spectral instability index
question: Relate the negative directions of a solitary-wave Hessian to unstable eigenvalues of the linearized Hamiltonian flow.
first_test: Produce an index equality under explicit kernel and essential-spectrum assumptions.

title: Nonradial solitary-wave families
question: Determine which nonradial profiles exist at fixed mass for the fourth-order cubic–quintic model and whether they bifurcate from radial branches.
first_test: Construct a nonsymmetric branch or prove rigidity in a fixed parameter regime.

title: Fission thresholds for coherent packets
question: Determine whether energetic and momentum constraints predict splitting of a localized wave into two or more persistent profiles.
first_test: Prove a sufficient fission criterion or construct a counterexample to a proposed criterion.

title: Nonlinear radiation tail asymptotics
question: Classify the sharp pointwise and weighted-space decay of radiation emitted by perturbations of a stable fourth-order solitary wave.
first_test: Establish a dispersive expansion including its leading coefficient and remainder.

title: Quasiperiodic localized dynamics
question: Determine whether genuinely localized solutions with two incommensurate temporal frequencies exist near a spectrally isolated coherent state.
first_test: Construct an invariant torus or prove a nonresonance obstruction.

title: Wavepacket capture versus passage
question: In a fixed localized defect potential, classify when a traveling wavepacket is trapped, reflected, or transmitted by nonlinear dynamics.
first_test: Prove one sharp scattering threshold for a frozen defect and incident family.

title: Phase-dependent interaction forces
question: Derive a controlled leading-order interaction force between two well-separated solitary profiles and determine how it changes with relative phase.
first_test: Establish a separation-dependent effective force with a quantified remainder.

title: Dynamics near an embedded internal eigenvalue
question: Determine whether a localized mode embedded in a radiation band persists under small Hamiltonian perturbations.
first_test: Find a structural protection theorem or derive its dissolution into a resonance.

title: Orbital instability growth rates
question: For an explicitly chosen unstable excited standing wave, determine the sharp nonlinear departure time as perturbation size tends to zero.
first_test: Match spectral exponential growth with a nonlinear bootstrap lower and upper bound.

title: High-frequency wave cascade obstruction
question: Determine whether finite-energy data can transfer arbitrarily much Sobolev mass to high frequencies while conserving mass and Hamiltonian.
first_test: Construct a cascade or prove a uniform high-norm bound in a stated regime.

title: Long-time interaction of three solitons
question: Classify whether three separated waves can exhibit persistent three-body interactions not captured by pairwise effective forces.
first_test: Derive a genuine three-body correction or prove pairwise reduction at leading order.

title: Breather persistence under model perturbations
question: For a specified small perturbation of an exactly periodic localized orbit, determine whether the orbit persists or radiates away.
first_test: Prove a persistence criterion or a radiation-induced obstruction.

title: Uniform stability near a bifurcation endpoint
question: Determine whether orbital-stability constants remain bounded as a solitary-wave branch approaches a fold or essential-spectrum edge.
first_test: Quantify degeneration of coercivity or establish a uniform neighborhood estimate.
